== Deck pages, 14 October 2026 ==
* HaysDark.html (Clint Hays' 1999 World Championship Dark deck) has no Wayback capture, so it has no page.
* Carl Mike Hardy's ''Alderaan Express'' (NEWS1-98) survives only as a 3 KB fragment of a Word 6.0 file titled "The Express hits the road running!", with no decklist.
* US.html is a 404 in every capture. Canada.html is an AOL "page not found" notice.
* Card names that match no card title are listed as the site gives them: "Coreillan/Correilan Freighter Captain" and "Hoth: Control Room" (Mind What You Are Told; New Sanctuary) and "Cloud City Plaza" (Sanctuary, 1999). These are left out of the GEMP files.
* "X-Wing Squadron" and "Y-Wing Squadron" (EBO With A Twist; Mind What You Are Told) are [[X-wing Assault Squadron]] and [[Y-wing Assault Squadron]], the only Decipher squadron cards for those ships by 2000. "Gold Squadron X-Wing" (New Sanctuary) is unlinked: it could be [[Red Squadron X-wing]] (Official Tournament Sealed Deck, paired with Gold Squadron Y-wing) or X-wing Assault Squadron.
* Formats marked "(from the card pool)" are the smallest format that fits the newest set and the capture date.
* The Northern California regional (Jeff Davis) and the GenCon Open (Alread's No Sanctuary) have no year on the site, so they have no event pages yet.
* The EBO With A Twist GEMP file is uploaded; the first attempt failed on unescaped quotes in a card title. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 13:20, 14 October 2026 (UTC)
